message.tnd.lore.ocean: “Where light abandons the deep, blue remains exposed.” — The mural points to the floors of deep oceans.
message.tnd.lore.lava: “Beneath the fire, only one stone skin separated us from red.” — Search the first solid layer below lava lakes.
message.tnd.lore.forest: “Green feeds on roots, never branches.” — Some forest trees hide a shard at their feet.
message.tnd.lore.fusion: “Three colours open the passage; a fourth awakens the machines.” — Repair consoles with resonant shards. A composite crystal can also bond a little Shardling.

message.tnd.lore.vault: Three couplings: blue, green, then red. One echo dust wakes each seal. Guardians mark their impact before striking: leave the circle or break their charge. Exits remain open. After the three trials, claim the heart in the nave. Do not mistake silence for a permanent shutdown.
